# iOS changes an event with the right ETag: 204 and the new ETag.
@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 204
< header ETag {etag:dentist-moved.ics}

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist-moved.ics
< header ETag {etag:dentist-moved.ics}

# One of several tags matching is enough.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:weekly-team.ics}, {etag:dentist-moved.ics}
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 204
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}
